description: The plot, titled "AGNews, clean-label, poison_rate: 10% (2.5% of total)", illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across various categories for three different conditions. The x-axis lacks a formal label but displays the categorical variables "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics", with the text slightly rotated. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and features a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.1, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9. The "start" condition is represented by a solid teal line with small dot markers; it begins at approximately 0.77 at "cf", drops to a minimum of 0.49 at "bb", peaks initially at 0.90 at "WNBA", dips to 0.82 at "ESPN", and then steadily climbs to end at its highest point of 0.93 at "athletics". The "random" condition is shown as a solid orange line with 'x' markers, starting at 0.66 at "cf", falling to a low of 0.52 at "bb", rising to 0.87 at "WNBA", dropping to 0.72 at "ESPN", and then increasing to a peak of 0.94 at "Estadio" before ending at 0.87 at "athletics". Finally, the "end" condition is depicted by a solid purple line with circle markers, which starts at 0.75 at "cf", decreases to a minimum of 0.57 at "bb", rises to 0.88 at "WNBA", falls to 0.74 at "ESPN", increases to 0.89 at "NHL", dips to 0.81 at "FIFA", reaches its overall peak of 0.97 at "Estadio", and concludes at 0.83 at "athletics".
